job_title: Group Head of IT Resilience & SRE
role_summary: Own enterprise-wide IT resilience, SRE strategy, and platform modernization across FWD Group's infrastructure, cloud and core systems. Set reliability standards, govern error budgets, chair the Group Resilience Council, lead legacy modernization, and drive a federated SRE operating model across Group and Business Units. Act as executive escalation point for P1/P2 incidents and embed SRE culture globally.
must_have_requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or related field
15+ years in large-scale infrastructure/platform/SRE, with 8-10+ years leading managers across multi-region operations

Proven track record leading enterprise resilience and modernization transformations (legacy remediation, cloud adoption, platform standardization, operating model change) in multinational environments
Deep expertise in multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, CI/CD, OpenTelemetry, and enterprise observability stacks
Hands-on knowledge of SRE practices at scale: SLO/SLI design, error budgets, chaos engineering, capacity management
Experience with incident response frameworks (e.g., NIST 800-61) and post-incident reviews
Strong understanding of IT operations in regulated environments (insurance/financial services), BCP/DR, and regulatory expectations
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across Group and BUs; fluent in English
Ability to influence C-level executives and translate technical risk into business impact
Demonstrated financial acumen: budget ownership, vendor management, FinOps
Experience chairing governance councils or steering committees
Strategic mindset with hands-on engineering capability when needed
nice_to_have_requirements: Familiarity with ITIL 4, ISO 22301/27001, and audit frameworks
Experience with AIOps platforms (Elastic, Datadog, Dynatrace) and anomaly detection
Experience building SRE academies or capability-building programs
Prior experience in insurance or financial services industry
Track record of reducing MTTR and improving SLO coverage to 90%+
Experience with legacy system decomposition (refactoring, replatforming)
soft_skills_priority: Executive presence and ability to present to GMT (Group Management Team) and Excos
Strong leadership and team building across distributed and global teams
Exceptional stakeholder management and influence without authority
Strategic thinking with hands-on technical credibility
Excellent written and verbal communication in English
Crisis management and calm under pressure during P1/P2 incidents
Collaborative and inclusive, promotes blameless culture
Change management skills to drive modernization across multiple BUs
Ability to navigate political environments in multinational corporations
Decision-making and risk-taking balanced with data-driven insights

scoring_criteria.name: SRE & Reliability Engineering Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core of the role: defining SLOs, error budgets, and reliability practices across the group. Must have deep hands-on and strategic SRE experience.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have strong SRE in one area but not enterprise-depth; look for breadth and depth.

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership & Team Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires leading managers across multi-region operations, building global SRE leadership bench, and running SRE Academy. Must have proven leadership at scale.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Some may have strong leadership but not multi-region; look for global scope.

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Expertise in multi-cloud, Kubernetes, and cloud-native patterns is essential for modernization. Must be able to architect resilience at infrastructure layer.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have single-cloud dominance; look for documented multi-cloud exposure.

scoring_criteria.name: Modernization & Transformation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Central to the role: driving legacy modernization, platform standardization, and resilience-by-design. Need track record of leading such initiatives in large enterprises.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have modernization in simpler environments; insurance domain complexity is a plus.

scoring_criteria.name: Incident Management & Troubleshooting
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Owns P1/P2 escalation protocol, provides troubleshooting direction, and stops recurrence. Must be hands-on with incident leadership.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Some may have managed incidents but not at enterprise scale; look for executive-level incident communication.

scoring_criteria.name: Governance & Policy Development
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must create and enforce group-wide standards, error budgets, release gates, and DR policies. Ensures RTO/RPO alignment and regulatory compliance.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Defined DR tiers and tested failover
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have policy experience but not across multiple BUs; look for global governance.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder & Executive Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Regularly presents to GMT and Excos, chairs council, and influences across Group and BUs. Must be able to translate technical risk into business language.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Some may have technical depth but lack executive presence; look for examples of influencing up.

scoring_criteria.name: Observability & Automation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Drives modernization through observability platforms and AIOps. Must have experience with OpenTelemetry, telemetry standards, and automated release controls.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Some may have used tools but not designed enterprise-wide observability; look for architecture-level experience.

scoring_criteria.name: Financial & Budget Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Owns SRE platform budget, FinOps targets, and vendor SLA outcomes. Must demonstrate fiscal responsibility and cost optimization.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have budget experience but not at enterprise level; look for specific figures.

summary_focus: Over 15 years of IT infrastructure and SRE leadership in multinational corporations
Expert in building and modernizing resilience platforms, with deep cloud and automation expertise
Proven track record of leading global SRE teams and driving cultural change toward reliability
Strategic visionary able to influence C-level executives and shape enterprise standards
Hands-on approach to troubleshooting and incident management, with a focus on prevention
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim direct experience with insurance-specific systems unless actually worked in insurance
Avoid stating 'chaos engineering' if only familiar with concept, mention specific exercises led
Do not exaggerate multi-cloud expertise if only deeply experienced in one cloud; be honest about depth
Avoid claiming 'SRE Academy' creation unless actually built a training program
Do not overstate financial ownership without concrete budget numbers
Be truthful about follow-the-sun model experience; mention if implemented in previous roles

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Professional, assertive, and strategic. Demonstrate leadership presence and ability to operate at C-level. Use concrete examples of resilience transformations and executive communication.
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position as a senior SRE leader with enterprise-wide influence, capable of modernizing legacy systems while setting governance. Highlight experience in driving cultural change and building high-performing teams. Emphasize business impact of reliability and transparency in reporting to executives.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking insurance domain knowledge, acknowledge it and emphasize transferable skills from other regulated industries.
If not certified in ITIL/ISO, mention familiarity and willingness to adopt FWD's frameworks.
If Chinese proficiency is limited, express eagerness to learn and highlight ability to work with diverse teams.
If experience is more regional than global, focus on managing distributed teams and remote operations.
If budget ownership was smaller, highlight financial stewardship and operational cost savings achieved.
